standard: course-sentence-translation 技能 R1–R4；键取自对齐原串

entries.en: Hi, Jack. How was school?
entries.zh: 嗨，杰克。学校怎么样？

entries.en: Oh, fine.
entries.zh: 哦，还行。

entries.en: Mum, can I bring some friends round tomorrow?
entries.zh: 妈妈，我明天能带几个朋友来家里吗？

entries.en: Sure.
entries.zh: 当然可以。

entries.en: Who?
entries.zh: 都有谁？

entries.en: Oh, probably Rachel and Steve, maybe Leo.
entries.zh: 哦，可能是雷切尔和史蒂夫，也许还有里奥。

entries.en: OK. Not Markus?
entries.zh: 好的。马库斯不来吗？

entries.en: Er, no.
entries.zh: 呃，不。

entries.en: Oh? Why not?
entries.zh: 哦？为什么不来？

entries.en: Well, we’re not really friends any more.
entries.zh: 嗯，我们不再是朋友了。

entries.en: Seriously? I thought you two were best friends.
entries.zh: 真的吗？我以为你们两个是最好的朋友。

entries.en: Yeah, we were.
entries.zh: 是的，我们以前是。

entries.en: But you know, we had an argument – he said something I didn’t like – so he’s not my friend any more.
entries.zh: 但你知道，我们吵了一架——他说了些我不喜欢的话——所以他不算是我的朋友了。

entries.en: And what did he say?
entries.zh: 他说了什么？

entries.en: Well, he called me silly.
entries.zh: 嗯，他叫我傻瓜。

entries.en: Friends don’t do that.
entries.zh: 朋友不会那样做。

entries.en: Jack, do you remember Mrs Gordon? Janice? She’s a friend of mine.
entries.zh: 杰克，你还记得戈登夫人吗？贾妮丝？她是我的一个朋友。

entries.en: Yes, I remember.
entries.zh: 记得，我记得。

entries.en: She was your friend at school too, wasn’t she?
entries.zh: 她以前上学时也是你的朋友，对吧？

entries.en: Yes, and we’re still friends now, 20 years later.
entries.zh: 对，而且我们现在还是朋友，20 年过去了。

entries.en: Her mother was a friend of my mother’s.
entries.zh: 她妈妈是我妈妈的一个朋友。

entries.en: Anyway, one day at school, well, we had an argument and I said something really horrible to her.
entries.zh: 总之，有一天在学校，我们吵了一架，我对她说了很糟糕的话。

entries.en: What?
entries.zh: 什么话？

entries.en: It doesn’t matter.
entries.zh: 没关系。

entries.en: But she walked away and said, ‘I never want to see you again.’
entries.zh: 但她走开了，说：“我再也不想见到你了。”

entries.en: I was really upset about that and I shouted, ‘Same here!’ or something.
entries.zh: 我当时特别难过，就喊了句“我也是！”之类的话。

entries.en: Then the next day, at school, she came up to me with a big smile and said, ‘Hi, Jenny, you OK?’
entries.zh: 然后第二天在学校，她带着灿烂的笑容走到我面前说：“嗨，珍妮，你还好吗？”

entries.en: Really?
entries.zh: 真的吗？

entries.en: Yes, I was completely surprised and I asked her, I said, ‘Aren’t you angry with me?’
entries.zh: 是啊，我完全没想到，就问她，我说：“你不生我的气吗？”

entries.en: And she said something I still remember.
entries.zh: 她说了句我至今都记得的话。

entries.en: She said: ‘Well, yes, I was angry but last night I thought of all the nice things you always say to me and the nice things you do.
entries.zh: 她说：“嗯，是的，我当时很生气，但昨晚我想到了你总是对我说的那些好话，还有你做过的那些好事。

entries.en: I want to think about that, not something you said because you were angry.’
entries.zh: 我想的是那些，而不是你生气时说的话。”

entries.en: And those words of hers, well, they almost made me cry.
entries.zh: 她的那些话，嗯，差点让我哭出来。

entries.en: And here we are, twenty years later, still friends.
entries.zh: 而现在我们，20 年过去了，仍然是朋友。

entries.en: Wow.
entries.zh: 哇。

entries.en: Cool story, Mum.
entries.zh: 真酷的故事，妈妈。

entries.en: So I think it’s a real shame that after such a long time, you can’t still be friends with Markus.
entries.zh: 所以我觉得很遗憾，过了这么久，你却不能再和马库斯做朋友。

entries.en: You’re right.
entries.zh: 你说得对。

entries.en: Wow, so many times he helped me with my homework, listened to me when I had a problem.
entries.zh: 哇，他有多少次帮我做作业，我遇到问题时听我倾诉。

entries.en: That’s right.
entries.zh: 没错。

entries.en: So he called you silly one time? So what?
entries.zh: 所以他有一次叫你傻瓜？那又怎样？

entries.en: And you know, sometimes you are stupid – just like everyone else.
entries.zh: 而且你知道，有时候你确实傻——就像其他人一样。

entries.en: Yes. Mum, I’m going out.
entries.zh: 是的。妈妈，我要出去了。

entries.en: Round to Markus’ place, OK?
entries.zh: 去马库斯家，好吗？

entries.en: Good idea, Jack, and why don’t you take him a present to say sorry?
entries.zh: 好主意，杰克，你为什么不带件礼物去跟他道歉呢？
